……………hrmm.

What is…

Search it.

A trap…!?
Hm? Praetor, where have you gone?

A glittering, shiny house!
I-I apologize for calling you a hunk of trash!
I wished for a redo.

My family wasn't super rich,
and I wasn't a 200 IQ genius nor beautiful.
But I was pretty happy.

A fairly strict household,
a fairly princess-like upbringing as an only daughter.

Since we were in the upper middle class,
I received a handsome inheritance.
"#C236196003Jinako#CDEF    obtained   inheritance!"

sometimes so mediocre that it ticked me off―

Rather than love mama, I admired her.
Mama was so kind and pretty that she was
way out of papa's league.

My family wasn't super rich,
and I wasn't a 200 IQ genius nor beautiful.
And yet.

I didn't go on to high school.
Since nobody told me to go,
I dragged myself into seclusion.

I mean, I had money for life.
No one could bother me.
Who could blame me if I used entertainment as an escape?

I would bluff by signing off with my usual line.
On the internet, #C236196003jinaKO#CDEF was a revered Game Champ.

I'm a winner. I'm a winner. I'm a winner.

That's why I joined.
…I wished for a redo.
I had given up on my life,

But no one told me anything about THIS.

D-did you just pop out of that sweet,

Come ON, do you even get how condescending

Stop it, for real…
I want to be here.

It hurts, anyhow.
It's hopeless for me…
I don't feel, anything, so…

So, ahhh…
It hurts… it hurts, it really hurts…
Why does it…?
I'm lonely…
Her #C000246204SG#CDEF is "#C000246204Loneliness#CDEF," huh…?

Good job for now, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

I'm sure she noticed us, but won't even cast a glance.

I took a single step forward,

If you insist on condemning yourself,

If you've got the time to be all down, drawing

Well, well. This putrid mass has outdone itself.
THAT is mankind's oldest posture
for gaining attention.

That position, to those who use it, is a demonic
skill for attracting even unknown strangers to
come talk―――Though, it does little for me.

Shut it…
Ugh, so annoying. Just blabberin' away.

And after I FINALLY #ROFS0002#RUBS   purged #RUBEseparated#REND from
that fussy mother-in-law of a Servant, #C236196003Karna#CDEF.

and quiet in this spot, either.
Doesn't really bother me. It is what it is.

Ain't it just SO great to have an admirable
Servant, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF!?
Death to survivalists.

She's gone…
I didn't even get a chance to speak.

Seems like #C236196003Jinako#CDEF,
after parting with her usual slang threat,

…that explains it.
The layout of the eleventh floor is 
sparsely structured so she can do that.
By layout, you mean the stuff in here…?

Erm, in order to teleport without limit,

The formula requires #RUBS      entrance#RUBEa divergence#REND and
a #ROFS0003#RUBS           promise of an exit#RUBEsingular point of convergence#REND. A Labyrinth
without this premise will end in collapse.

…oh. As immense as #C236196003BB#CDEF's power is, that's why

A solution we can't discover―――but #C236196003BB#CDEF also

…honestly, I'm not really following…
But I get the feeling it's
like the repetition-draw rule in chess…

#C236196003#NICK#CDEF, #C236196003#SVT#CDEF? Sorry for this,
but please keep #C000246204searching for Jinako#CDEF.
Stay on her tail!

Good.
These are rare and wise military staff officers.
Elites that conquerors of any age would envy.

Moreover, with me as your blade, they serve as
the cane that supports you, Praetor. We can
clear a Labyrinth like this in no time.

Great… Thanks for the reassuring encouragement.
They're fast-talkers and they don't mince

After all, our greatest threat from this
Labyrinth might just be boredom.

There's no reason why we would lose.
#C236196003Jinako#CDEF is alone. But we're two people
because there's two of us.

After all, "1 plus 1 equals #RUBS   Love#RUBE鷙#REND"!
Isn't that right, Darling?

There's no method more tedious than that,

It seems this will become a question of

You have logistical support, after all.

Sure, this seems like it'll be plain work,

I have not only #C236196003#SVT#CDEF with me,

…but… I wonder if that's all there is to it.

This landscape from her mind,

I get the feeling that we shouldn't just

Again, yo?
You just don't know when to quit, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

…go ahead, keep searching. It's pointless.
#C236196003Jinako#CDEF is an authority on re-playthroughs.

Repetitive speedruns, infinite duping―

So actually, I welcome it.

I was ready this time, but she got away
again like it was nothing.
What am I supposed to do?
The previous Labyrinths had
corridors with dead-ends, but here…

Only one option, I guess.
Right under the realm of expectation.
Let's go, before our feet get sore.
…ugh. Not much choice, is there?

I mean, compared to being the one chased,
there's NO STRESS in being the chaser.
…take it from me.

Struggling, isn't she?
Time for you two mongrels to show
off your willpower.

Once again we ran into #C236196003Jinako#CDEF,

Looking at her from the side, I can't tell if
she's getting fed up with being chased around.
All I can see is that she looks more spaced out than ever…

Okay! Okay, okay, okay, okay―――
Just let ME handle this.
First, let's break her knees.

Oh, please. I don't mean it literally. I just
want to teach her about being moderate in all
things. Even despots care about aesthetics.

―――What do we do?
Did you come up with a plan, Master?

Bind her neat～ Bind her neat～♪
With this chant, seal her feet～♪

Please ignore the similarity to tales like
"The Three Charms," with their whole
"use this magic to get away"#ROFS-007#RUBSkind of thing#RUBE motif#REND.

So, third time's the charm?
What will you do?
I can do this my own way, if you wish.
Try something on my own.
All she'll do is act stubborn, anyway.
All we can do is persevere.

Besides, I know from my battles against
#C236196003Rin#CDEF and #C236196003Rani#CDEF that it's impossible to extract
an #C000246204SG#CDEF via brute force.

…………I'm so sick of this.
Why do you hafta drag things out?

These days, stern lectures and night patrol
teachers are uhh-novel (i.e. pointless).
It suits that old school, though.

THIS is the quantum age, yo. What do you know,
#C236196003#NICK#CDEF? You with your #SVT[old hag of a][anachronism of a][worn-out][unfathomably ancient]# 
Servant, going out for walks by choice.

I would be lying if I said I wasn't swelling with anger.
Yet, this #C236196003Jinako#CDEF is precisely a product
of #C236196003BB#CDEF splitting up her personality.
I can't go losing it over each
and every one of her sarcastic comments.

Don't pay me any more mind.
#C236196003Jinako#CDEF's got friends too, you know?
………………heeerrre we go.

……………*sigh*.
Now she's gone and made a fool of
herself for the THIRD time…

So she says she "has friends"?
There's no better final refuge to take.

This is… a model house, I guess?
It seems like it has some meaning behind it…

Well isn't this cute?
Shall we look at the interio―the door
won't open. It's welded shut.

Isn't this just some objet d'art?
The door, windows, and walls are all one,
single piece. It's just a paperweight then.

Hmm, this is terrible. Could they have cut any
more corners? It's like, a hunk of trash. The
windows and door seem to be mere decoration.

Heh. Only YOU would look at this and
see a model house, mongrel.

Note the roof, not the walls!
This is unmistakably one of THOSE. My intuition
never fails when it comes to all THOSE.

With #C236196003#SVT#CDEF speaking behind me,
I search over the model house.

…I see.
The doors and windows really are decorations.
Instead, this, the roof opens.

I place my hands on the roof
and try opening it like a treasure chest.

There's… smoke…!?
Did we really fall for the oldest trap
in the book? You okay, Master!? …Master?

No matter the design, a home is
filled with the husband's dreams. This is the
natural punishment for my ridicule.

But if little old #C236196003Tamamo#CDEF HAD the choice,
I would love a house with a pool, Darrrrllling鷙
Darling? Hello, Darling?

Argh! How tactless, blinding us like that…!
THESE are the creatures I loathe the most!
Even more than those summertime pests!

Know this, mongrel. Treasure chest-mimicking
knaves have been known since ancient times as
deception-devourers… hm? Where did you go?

To redo my life.
Up until I was fifteen years old,
I thought that way as if it were natural,
and I expected it to happen in the future
as if it were natural.

"If only I could get that chance."
I joined the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF,
half for fun, half for my wish.

Without knowing that it was a serious slaughter-fest;
a deathmatch where only one person can be left standing.

No, I had known the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF's rules from the rumors.
But not taking things seriously is a bad habit of mine.

Countless times so far,
I had spent my days with a "whatever" attitude―
So this was the greatest punishment I could have ever deserved.

It was papa who named me "#C236196003Jinako#CDEF."
Mama was Japanese, and he loved her just the way she was.
Of course, he also loved Japanese culture.
"I'd like her name to sound like a little Japanese girl."

Apparently over something like that,
he picked the sound of "#C236196003Jinako#CDEF."
One day, papa and mama passed away in an unfortunate accident.

Although, one could also view it as enough
money for a single girl to keep food on
the table for the rest of her life, if she lives modestly.

That's when the curtains opened
on my new life as a winner.

Obviously I didn't move up to high school.
There was no point, after all.

I holed up in my house and immersed myself
in the world of the internet.
I had tons of friends over in Piece Journal.

"You can live off your inheritance, #C236196003Jinako#CDEF?"
"You can just chill and not have to work?"
"So basically, you're a winner?"

Sometimes there would be people saying
dumb stuff out of envy, but it wasn't all
that bad of a daily life.

"As long as this lifestyle keeps up,
everything will be good," I thought.
This lifestyle, this lifestyle, this lifestyle―――

#C255045045Who would've guessed that this lifestyle―
would go on for fifteen years.#CDEF

But I was still pretty happy.
I had no wish for anything special,
but to make up for it, I had a realistic, 
down-to-earth happiness.

One day, papa and mama just disappeared.
While out shopping, a dump truck that
should've stopped at the light rammed through―
They just disappeared without a trace.

My world was plunged into darkness,
and then my mind was in darkness,
even after the funeral ended.
In such a state, I received my inheritance.

My internet buddies were nice to me.
As long as you don't step on any toes,
these friendships last forever.
For a year, five years, even ten years.

Until my friends, first one, and then another,
started saying "I'm moving on."

Because they needed money.
Because they were getting married.
Because their life was a mess.
"Nah, c'mon. You know NEETs are the REAL winners."

But on returning to the real world,
all that sat there was an indecipherable human being.

Financially, I had nothing to worry about.
Living expenses would be no obstacle until my dying day.
I could live like this my entire life.
My entire life. My entire life. My entire life―like this…?

My head misty, I end up sleeping with sheets
piled all over me to escape it all.

I mean, I'm popular on the internet.
And I don't need to go outside.
And I could get my hands on most anything.
Oh, but―――

Unaware, and before I had even realized it,
I had answered with my usual phrase, "whatever."
